newsitem.title: USA: Florida family may have suffered second murder.
newsitem.headline: Florida family may have suffered second murder.

text.p: A Florida family that lost one member to a notorious serial killer seven years ago said Friday they believe another relative has been killed.
Carla Larson disappeared shortly after noon Tuesday. A body found in dense woods near Walt Disney World, where she worked, late Thursday may be that of the 30-year-old building engineer, police said.
They said they will not positively identify the body until they can compare dental records, but Orange County homicide investigator Mike Easton said the family was being realistic.
Larson's husband, Jim, is the brother of Sonja Larson, one of five Gainesville college students murdered in 1990 by serial killer Danny Rolling.

"We were ready for this," Jim Larson said. "She was gone so long and there was always the chance it was going to end this way. After losing my sister, you just don't tell yourself, 'This couldn't happen to me.'"
Police in May found five bodies in Orlando's tourist district, which includes Disney World, Disney-MGM Studios, Universal Studios Florida, Sea World and other attractions.

Although the area is the world's favourite tourist destination, it includes thousands of acres of undeveloped land earmarked for theme-park expansions. The combination of heavily used highways and large tracts of woodlands make the area a good place to dump bodies, police said.
